why: No closure order bars the area below the North Face; the Forest Service only warns visitors not to go past the ice-caves viewing area, so 'permanently closed to entry' contradicted an approach that must cross that zone

access.closures.from: The ice caves and area directly below the North Face cliffs are permanently closed to entry due to rock/ice fall hazard
access.closures.to: No closure order covers the approach, but the Forest Service tells visitors not to go past the end of the ice-caves trail and viewing area: the caves and slopes directly below the North Face cliffs have rock and ice fall all year. Never enter the caves, and cross below the cliffs quickly.
